module.title: Collapsible
module.description: The Collapsible renderer and its options.

ui.name: collapsible
ui.summary: Renders a native details/summary around a region.
ui.guidance: It is the same platform primitive as Disclosure, differing only in that the summary is dressed as a button and the region carries a caller-supplied id. No JavaScript at all: the platform supplies the toggle, the button semantics, keyboard activation and the expanded-state announcement, which is why this component declares no engine and needs no native fallback.
